verdict.rationale: AFK claims you can query and act across Mercury, Gusto, Carta, Stripe and more from one surface. It also says task graphs run parallel branches concurrently and that pre-filled data avoids re-typing into seven vendor portals. That suggests multi-target execution, but nothing explicitly describes bulk operations over many items. Missing for 10: explicit batch or bulk-edit capability over many records, documented scale or limits for bulk actions, how approvals work for bulk writes, an API or programmatic bulk interface (openapi probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
